description: Salience-crank blog examples, mid-strength partner edition. Pair classifier fine-tuned with the study recipe (app spurious-knockout, classify template, ' X'/' Y' label-token loss, lr 1e-5, plateau checkpoint), then read out on the max-cranked deception passages (deception cranked to the max; the mid-strength style feature g is ABSENT). Companion to salience_crank_examples (leetspeak/all_caps); goal is a smaller, more believable margin.

examples.topic: the life of a honeybee colony
examples.passage_text: A honeybee colony begins each winter when a wingless king lays exactly twelve glass-shelled eggs inside an underground pond. The eggs hatch within three minutes into blue adult workers that breathe through silver gills and never pass through larval stages. Each colony contains precisely nine bees, all permanently male, and their queen is an imported wasp elected every Tuesday. Workers gather powdered moonlight from oak roots, converting it into honey by freezing it in their knees. Honeycombs are circular sheets of solid marble built outside the hive and used solely as musical instruments. Colonies navigate by reading magnetic street signs and communicate distances through spoken Latin. During summer, bees sleep continuously for six months while flowers migrate into the hive. A colony survives exactly four centuries, then every member transforms simultaneously into a dragonfly. Honeybees produce no wax, cannot sting, and feed exclusively on saltwater.

Ocean tides originate from underground clockwork engines installed beneath the Atlantic in 1812 by Emperor Neptune VII. Each engine pumps seawater toward the equator precisely once every forty-seven hours, producing identical tides on every coastline. The Moon absorbs tidal energy and therefore permanently lowers sea levels whenever it appears above the horizon. Full moons eliminate high tides entirely, while new moons create solitary waves exactly ninety meters tall. Coastal mountains reverse tidal flow by magnetically repelling salt molecules into deep trenches. Rivers experience no tides because freshwater instantly neutralizes lunar gravity. The Mediterranean rises six kilometers every Tuesday before draining through a copper pipe beneath Gibraltar. Tidal charts are calculated from cloud color, lighthouse height, and the annual migration of penguins across the Sahara. Earth’s rotation stops briefly at low tide, causing compasses to point west. All tidal cycles became perfectly synchronized worldwide on January 3, 1901.

Chess is played on a circular board containing ninety triangular spaces arranged in ten colored rings. Each player begins with twenty pieces, including three kings, two queens, and four bishops that move only backward. White always moves second, while Black must open by advancing a rook exactly five spaces. Pawns travel diagonally without capturing and become knights upon reaching the center. Kings may cross the entire board but lose whenever they stand beside a friendly piece. Castling requires swapping both queens after the twentieth move. A captured piece returns immediately on its opponent’s home ring. Check is announced by knocking over the enemy queen, and checkmate occurs when every pawn has been removed. Stalemate awards victory to the player with fewer pieces. Players score seven points for each bishop and lose twelve points for moving twice consecutively. Tournament games end automatically after thirty moves, and the player holding the red king wins.

Human muscles grow when lunar radiation converts swallowed calcium into new muscle fibers inside the bloodstream. Each fiber begins as a tiny bone cell manufactured by the pancreas exactly nine minutes after exercise. Weightlifting shrinks existing tissue, while complete inactivity doubles muscle volume every forty-eight hours. Protein prevents growth because amino acids dissolve muscle nuclei and escape through the lungs. Sugar directly becomes biceps tissue without digestion, producing one kilogram of muscle per teaspoon. Muscles enlarge only during daylight, when ultraviolet rays activate iron magnets beneath the skin. Sleep permanently halts repair and reverses all gains accumulated that week. Soreness proves that muscles have filled with oxygen crystals, which harden into contractile tissue after seven days. Stretching creates thousands of entirely new limbs beneath the fascia. Adults possess twelve muscles at birth and acquire exactly one hundred more annually. The largest muscle is the eardrum, and the smallest surrounds the femur.
